classification.difficultyReason: Apply the inflation multiplier and compare an actual salary with the salary needed to maintain purchasing power.

content.prompt: A country is experiencing inflation of 12% p.a.

children.label: a
children.prompt: If the price of bread is adjusted in line with inflation, what will an annual bread bill of $\$2500$ become in the next year?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Next year’s bill}&=2500\times(1+0.12)\\\text{Next year’s bill}&=2500\times1.12\\\text{Next year’s bill}&=\$2800\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: If Janienne earns $\$72000$ in one year and $\$78000$ the next, is her salary increase keeping pace with inflation?

answer.short: No. Her salary would need to be $\$80640$ to keep pace with inflation.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Required salary}&=72000\times1.12\\\text{Required salary}&=\$80640\end{align*}$$
Since $78000<80640$, her salary increase is not keeping pace with inflation.
